```luau
--!strict
-- PlotBuilder: builds the baseplate and one tycoon plot per slot, entirely from parts.

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))

local BASE_THICKNESS = 1
local LIFT = 0.05 -- plot sits slightly above the baseplate top so surfaces are never coplanar
local SPAWN_LOCAL = Vector3.new(0, 3, 12)
local CONVEYOR_Z = -8

export type Plot = {
	origin: CFrame,
	spawnCFrame: CFrame,
	conveyor: Part,
	conveyorDir: Vector3,
	droppers: { Part },
	dropperSlot2: Part,
	collector: Part,
	dropperButton: Part,
	conveyorButton: Part,
}

local PlotBuilder = {}

local plotsFolder: Folder? = nil

local function getPlotsFolder(): Folder
	if plotsFolder and plotsFolder.Parent then
		return plotsFolder
	end
	local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		plotsFolder = existing
		return existing
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = "Plots"
	f.Parent = Workspace
	plotsFolder = f
	return f
end

local function plotX(index: number): number
	return (index - 1) * Config.PLOT_SPACING
end

local function surfaceY(): number
	return LIFT + Config.PLOT_SIZE.Y
end

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, cf: CFrame, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, parent: Instance): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Anchored = true
	p.Size = size
	p.CFrame = cf
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = material
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end

local function addLabel(button: Part, text: string, guiName: string?, textColor: Color3?)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = guiName or "CostLabel"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 70)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
	gui.MaxDistance = 120
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	gui.Adornee = button
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Text"
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	label.TextColor3 = textColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = gui
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.Parent = label
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	corner.Parent = label
	gui.Parent = button
end

-- Marks a buy pad as purchased: recolors it and updates its label.
-- Can be called directly, or triggered by setting the pad attribute "Bought" = true.
function PlotBuilder.markPadBought(pad: Part)
	pad.Color = Config.BOUGHT_COLOR
	pad.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local gui = pad:FindFirstChild("CostLabel")
	if gui then
		local tl = gui:FindFirstChild("Text")
		if tl and tl:IsA("TextLabel") then
			tl.Text = "Bought!"
		end
	end
end

-- Reveals the second dropper after purchase.
-- Can be called directly, or triggered by setting the dropper attribute "Unlocked" = true.
function PlotBuilder.unlockDropper(dropper: Part)
	dropper.Transparency = 0
	dropper.CanCollide = true
	local gui = dropper:FindFirstChild("LockLabel")
	if gui then
		gui:Destroy()
	end
end

local function watchBought(pad: Part)
	pad:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Bought"):Connect(function()
		if pad:GetAttribute("Bought") == true then
			PlotBuilder.markPadBought(pad)
		end
	end)
end

local function watchUnlocked(dropper: Part)
	dropper:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Unlocked"):Connect(function()
		if dropper:GetAttribute("Unlocked") == true then
			PlotBuilder.unlockDropper(dropper)
		end
	end)
end

function PlotBuilder.buildBase(): Part
	local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
	if existing and existing:IsA("Part") then
		return existing
	end

	local width = Config.MAX_PLOTS * Config.PLOT_SPACING + 80
	local base = makePart(
		"Baseplate",
		Vector3.new(width, BASE_THICKNESS, 220),
		CFrame.new((Config.MAX_PLOTS - 1) * Config.PLOT_SPACING / 2, -BASE_THICKNESS / 2, 0),
		Color3.fromRGB(235, 240, 250),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		Workspace
	)

	-- Invisible default spawn near plot 1 so early joins land on a plot.
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "DefaultSpawn"
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.2, 6)
	spawn.CFrame = CFrame.new(plotX(1) + SPAWN_LOCAL.X, surfaceY() + 0.1, SPAWN_LOCAL.Z)
	spawn.Transparency = 1
	spawn.CanCollide = false
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.Parent = Workspace

	return base
end

function PlotBuilder.buildPlot(index: number): Plot
	local idx = math.clamp(math.floor(index), 1, Config.MAX_PLOTS)
	local x = plotX(idx)
	local top = surfaceY()
	local origin = CFrame.new(x, top, 0)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Plot" .. idx

	local function at(lx: number, ly: number, lz: number): CFrame
		return origin * CFrame.new(lx, ly, lz)
	end

	-- Ground
	makePart("PlotFloor", Config.PLOT_SIZE, CFrame.new(x, LIFT + Config.PLOT_SIZE.Y / 2, 0),
		Config.PLOT_COLOR, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)

	-- Spawn mat (slightly raised, not coplanar)
	makePart("SpawnMat", Vector3.new(8, 0.1, 8), at(SPAWN_LOCAL.X, 0.12, SPAWN_LOCAL.Z),
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)

	-- Conveyor (thin, long; top surface at +0.65 above plot surface)
	local len = Config.CONVEYOR_LENGTH
	local conveyor = makePart("Conveyor", Vector3.new(len, 0.6, 4), at(0, 0.35, CONVEYOR_Z),
		Config.CONVEYOR_COLOR, Enum.Material.Metal, model)

	-- Rails keep cubes on the belt
	for i, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		makePart("Rail" .. i, Vector3.new(len, 2, 0.4), at(0, 1.05, CONVEYOR_Z + side * 2.2),
			Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	end

	-- Droppers hover above the belt start
	local d1 = makePart("Dropper1", Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), at(-len / 2 + 2, 6, CONVEYOR_Z),
		Config.DROPPER_COLOR, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	local d2 = makePart("Dropper2", Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), at(-len / 2 + 8, 6, CONVEYOR_Z),
		Config.BOUGHT_COLOR, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	d2.Transparency = 0.6
	d2.CanCollide = false
	addLabel(d2, "LOCKED - buy 2nd Dropper", "LockLabel", Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120))
	watchUnlocked(d2)

	-- Collector at the belt end
	local collector = makePart("Collector", Vector3.new(3, 3, 4), at(len / 2 + 1.5, 1.55, CONVEYOR_Z),
		Config.COLLECTOR_COLOR, Enum.Material.Neon, model)

	-- Buy pads on the sides, far from spawn and the belt
	local dropperButton = makePart("DropperButton", Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 6), at(-15, 0.25, 14),
		Config.BUTTON_COLOR, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
	addLabel(dropperButton, "2nd Dropper $" .. Config.DROPPER_COST)
	watchBought(dropperButton)
	local conveyorButton = makePart("ConveyorButton", Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 6), at(15, 0.25, 14),
		Config.BUTTON_COLOR, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
	addLabel(conveyorButton, "Fast Belt $" .. Config.CONVEYOR_COST)
	watchBought(conveyorButton)

	model.Parent = getPlotsFolder()

	return {
		origin = origin,
		spawnCFrame = origin * CFrame.new(SPAWN_LOCAL),
		conveyor = conveyor,
		conveyorDir = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
		droppers = { d1, d2 },
		dropperSlot2 = d2,
		collector = collector,
		dropperButton = dropperButton,
		conveyorButton = conveyorButton,
	}
end

return PlotBuilder
```

## Problem
Feature to add: Themed plots and plot claiming for multiplayer: build a bright central spawn plaza (stone tiles, a fountain, lamp posts, trees) with 6 plots arranged in a ring around it. Each plot has its own theme with distinct floor material, colors and 3-5 decoration props built from parts: Candy (pink/mint, lollipops), Lava (basalt + glowing neon cracks), Ice (glacier/ice, crystals), Jungle (grass, palm trees), Neon City (dark slate floor, neon strips), Desert (sand, cacti). No grey or default-colored parts anywhere: the conveyor rails, dropper bodies and pads take the plot's theme colors. Players spawn in the plaza and walk onto a glowing CLAIM gate at the front of an empty plot (BillboardGui 'Claim <Theme> Plot') to claim it; the plot then shows a sign with the owner's name, starts the dropper, and only the owner can use its pads. One plot per player; a player's plot is freed when they leave. If a player has not claimed within 20 seconds, auto-claim the nearest free plot for them so the loop always starts.
Change needed in this file: Change the plot slot layout from the current single or linear plots to 6 slots on a ring around the plaza center, using the ring and plot size values from PlotThemes and rotating each plot to face the center. Accept a theme per slot, and color the conveyor rails, dropper bodies, collector and both buy pads from the theme palette instead of default or grey colors. Call PlazaBuilder.decoratePlot and buildClaimGate per slot, and return the slot list with the model, gate, theme and pad references. Keep bumping 'map_built' once.
New feature files: ReplicatedStorage/PlotThemes.luau, ServerScriptService/PlazaBuilder.luau, ServerScriptService/PlotClaimService.luau. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: plaza_built, themes_built, plots_claimed, auto_claims.

## Context
Watch cubes roll down your conveyor, cash in, and buy droppers and speed upgrades to grow your tiny factory!

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

```luau
-- PriceBillboard: world price tag over a buy pad / shop item; green when affordable, red when not. Server or client.
-- Standalone (no Theme needed) so a server Script can paste it too.
local function priceBillboard(part: BasePart, title: string, price: number): (BillboardGui, (boolean) -> ())
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size, bb.StudsOffset = UDim2.fromScale(6, 2.2), Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.LightInfluence = false, 80, 0
	bb.Adornee = part
	local function text(t: string, y: number, h: number, color: Color3): TextLabel
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position, l.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, h), UDim2.fromScale(0, y), 1
		l.Text, l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = t, Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, true, color
		local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		s.Thickness, s.Color = 3, Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
		s.Parent = l
		l.Parent = bb
		return l
	end
	text(title, 0, 0.45, Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
	local cost = text("$" .. tostring(price), 0.45, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64))
	bb.Parent = part
	local function setAffordable(ok: boolean)
		cost.TextColor3 = if ok then Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92) else Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
	end
	return bb, setAffordable -- client: call setAffordable(cash.Value >= price) on cash.Changed
end
```

```luau
--!strict

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PlotThemes: any = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlotThemes"))

-- ---------- helpers for reading PlotThemes defensively ----------

local function pick(t: any, keys: { string }): any
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		local v = t[k]
		if v ~= nil then
			return v
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function pickColor(t: any, keys: { string }, default: Color3): Color3
	local v = pick(t, keys)
	if typeof(v) == "Color3" then

	end
	return default

local function pickMaterial(t: any, keys: { string }, default: Enum.Material): Enum.Material
	local v = pick(t, keys)
	if typeof(v) == "EnumItem" and v.EnumType == Enum.Material then
		return v :: any
	end
	return default
end

local function ringRadius(): number
	local v = pick(PlotThemes, { "RING_RADIUS", "RingRadius", "ringRadius", "RADIUS", "Radius" })
	if type(v) == "number" then
		return v
	end
	return 120
end

local function plazaCenter(): Vector3
	local v = pick(PlotThemes, { "PLAZA_CENTER", "PlazaCenter", "CENTER", "Center", "center" })
	if typeof(v) == "Vector3" then

	end
	return Vector3.zero
end

local function slotCount(): number

	local sss = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local m = sss:WaitForChild("PlazaBuilder", 5)

	local center = plazaCenter()

		CFrame.new(center.X, -BASE_THICKNESS / 2, center.Z),
		Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 130),
		Enum.Material.Grass,
		Workspace
	)

	-- Invisible default spawn in the plaza (offset from the fountain at the center).
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "DefaultSpawn"
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.2, 6)
	spawn.CFrame = CFrame.new(center.X, surfaceY() + 0.1, center.Z - 22)
	spawn.Transparency = 1
	spawn.CanCollide = false
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.Parent = Workspace

	return base
end

function PlotBuilder.buildPlot(index: number, themeIn: any?): Plot
	local count = slotCount()
	local idx = math.clamp(math.floor(index), 1, count)
	local theme: any = themeIn or getTheme(idx)
	local name = themeName(theme)

	local floorColor = pickColor(theme, { "floorColor", "floor", "groundColor", "ground" }, DEFAULT_THEME.floorColor)
	local floorMaterial = pickMaterial(theme, { "floorMaterial", "material", "groundMaterial" }, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	local primary = pickColor(theme, { "primary", "primaryColor", "colorA", "color1" }, DEFAULT_THEME.primary)
	local secondary = pickColor(theme, { "secondary", "secondaryColor", "colorB", "color2" }, DEFAULT_THEME.secondary)
	local accent = pickColor(theme, { "accent", "accentColor", "glow", "glowColor" }, DEFAULT_THEME.accent)

	local center = plazaCenter()
	local angle = (idx - 1) / count * math.pi * 2
	local radius = ringRadius()
	local pos = Vector3.new(center.X + math.sin(angle) * radius, 0, center.Z + math.cos(angle) * radius)
	local top = surfaceY()
	-- local +Z (pads, claim gate) faces the plaza center
	local lookAtCenter = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(pos.X, top, pos.Z), Vector3.new(center.X, top, center.Z))
	local origin = lookAtCenter * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)

	local size = plotSize()
	local thickness = Config.PLOT_SIZE.Y
	local halfZ = size.Z / 2

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Plot" .. idx
	model:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", idx)
	model:SetAttribute("ThemeName", name)
	model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", 0)

	local function at(lx: number, ly: number, lz: number): CFrame
		return origin * CFrame.new(lx, ly, lz)
	end

	-- Ground
	local floor = makePart("PlotFloor", Vector3.new(size.X, thickness, size.Z), at(0, -thickness / 2, 0),
		floorColor, floorMaterial, model)
	model.PrimaryPart = floor

	-- Spawn mat (slightly raised, not coplanar)
	makePart("SpawnMat", Vector3.new(8, 0.1, 8), at(SPAWN_LOCAL.X, 0.12, SPAWN_LOCAL.Z),
		secondary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)

	-- Conveyor (thin, long; top surface at +0.65 above plot surface)
	local len = Config.CONVEYOR_LENGTH
	local conveyor = makePart("Conveyor", Vector3.new(len, 0.6, 4), at(0, 0.35, CONVEYOR_Z),
		Config.CONVEYOR_COLOR, Enum.Material.Metal, model)

	-- Rails keep cubes on the belt (theme colored)
	for i, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		makePart("Rail" .. i, Vector3.new(len, 2, 0.4), at(0, 1.05, CONVEYOR_Z + side * 2.2),
			accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	end

	-- Droppers hover above the belt start
	local d1 = makePart("Dropper1", Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), at(-len / 2 + 2, 6, CONVEYOR_Z),
		primary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	local d2 = makePart("Dropper2", Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), at(-len / 2 + 8, 6, CONVEYOR_Z),
		secondary, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, model)
	d2.Transparency = 0.6
	d2.CanCollide = false
	addLabel(d2, "LOCKED - buy 2nd Dropper", "LockLabel", Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 120))
	watchUnlocked(d2)

	-- Collector at the belt end
	local collector = makePart("Collector", Vector3.new(3, 3, 4), at(len / 2 + 1.5, 1.55, CONVEYOR_Z),
		accent, Enum.Material.Neon, model)

	-- Buy pads on the sides, off the spawn/gate path
	local dropperButton = makePart("DropperButton", Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 6), at(-15, 0.25, 14),
		primary, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
	dropperButton:SetAttribute("BoughtColor", BOUGHT_GREEN)
	addLabel(dropperButton, "2nd Dropper $" .. Config.DROPPER_COST)
	watchBought(dropperButton)
	local conveyorButton = makePart("ConveyorButton", Vector3.new(6, 0.4, 6), at(15, 0.25, 14),
		accent, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
	conveyorButton:SetAttribute("BoughtColor", BOUGHT_GREEN)
	addLabel(conveyorButton, "Fast Belt $" .. Config.CONVEYOR_COST)
	watchBought(conveyorButton)

	model.Parent = getPlotsFolder()

	-- Decorations and claim gate come from the plaza builder
	local plaza = loadPlaza()
	if plaza and type(plaza.decoratePlot) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			plaza.decoratePlot(model, theme, origin, size)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[PlotBuilder] decoratePlot failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end

	local gate: BasePart? = nil
	if plaza and type(plaza.buildClaimGate) == "function" then
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			return plaza.buildClaimGate(model, theme, origin, size, idx)
		end)
		if ok then
			gate = toBasePart(res)
		else
			warn("[PlotBuilder] buildClaimGate failed: " .. tostring(res))
		end
	end
	if gate == nil then
		local g = makePart("ClaimGate", Vector3.new(14, 0.6, 6), at(0, 0.35, math.max(halfZ - 5, 18)),
			accent, Enum.Material.Neon, model)
		g.CanCollide = false
		g:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", idx)
		addLabel(g, "Claim " .. name .. " Plot", "ClaimLabel", Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232))
		gate = g
	end
	if gate then
		gate:SetAttribute("PlotIndex", idx)
	end

	return {
		index = idx,
		origin = origin,
		spawnCFrame = origin * CFrame.new(SPAWN_LOCAL),
		conveyor = conveyor,
		conveyorDir = origin.RightVector,
		droppers = { d1, d2 },
		dropperSlot2 = d2,
		collector = collector,
		dropperButton = dropperButton,
		conveyorButton = conveyorButton,
		model = model,
		gate = gate,
		theme = theme,
	}
end

-- Builds every slot on the ring (one theme per slot) and returns the slot list.
function PlotBuilder.buildSlots(themes: { any }?): { Plot }
	if #builtSlots > 0 then
		return builtSlots
	end
	local count = slotCount()
	local slots: { Plot } = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local theme: any = if themes then themes[i] else nil
		slots[i] = PlotBuilder.buildPlot(i, theme)
	end
	builtSlots = slots

	if not mapBuiltCounted then
		mapBuiltCounted = true
		local tel = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
		if tel then
			local ok, mod = pcall(require, tel)
			if ok and type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.count) == "function" then
				mod.count("map_built", 1)
			end
		end
	end
	return slots
end

function PlotBuilder.getSlots(): { Plot }
	return builtSlots
end

return PlotBuilder
```

I couldn't see `PlotThemes` or `PlazaBuilder`, so the field and function names for them are guesses. Nothing here has been run.

- **`PlotThemes` fields:** I read the ring radius, plot size, plaza center and theme list under several likely key names. Theme colors and floor material are read the same way, with fallbacks for anything missing. If your module uses different names, the ring and palette fall back to my defaults instead of erroring.
- **`PlazaBuilder` calls:** I call `decoratePlot(model, theme, origin, size)` and `buildClaimGate(model, theme, origin, size, idx)` inside `pcall`. If the gate call fails or returns no part, the file builds its own glowing "Claim <Theme> Plot" gate so the plot still has one.
- **`map_built`:** this file didn't bump it before. I added a single bump inside the new `buildSlots` (which builds all six slots and returns the list). If your main script already bumps it, the counter will read 2.
- **Spawn:** the default spawn moved from plot 1 to the plaza, 22 studs off the center. I put it there to keep it clear of the fountain, but I haven't checked it against where `PlazaBuilder` puts the fountain and lamp posts.
- **Plot layout:** the pads and claim gate sit on the side of each plot facing the plaza. The conveyor sits at the back. `conveyorDir` is now each plot's rotated right vector rather than world +X. Anything that assumed +X will need to use `conveyorDir`.
- **Colors:** rails, droppers, collector and both pads take the theme palette. A bought pad turns a fixed mint green instead of `Config.BOUGHT_COLOR`.
